paraphrase: Of Baizhang: in work he shared the labour equally with the assembly and always said, 'a day without work, a day without food'.

original.text: 至於作務。猶與眾均其勞。常曰。一日不作一日不食
original.edition: CBETA XML P5, Taishō T48n2025 (Chixiu Baizhang qinggui 勅修百丈清規), vol. 48, from line 1119b01

speaker: compilers (of Baizhang)
notes: The saying is attributed to Baizhang in Song-Yuan sources; the compilers place it in their account of the rise of the abbacy.
translation_basis: own paraphrase made directly from the Chinese text read locally (CBETA); no published translation consulted

paraphrase: The procedure of the universal invitation (puqing): high and low equally lend their strength; the work board is hung, all except those on duty, the old and the sick go to the work site, 'mindful of the ancients' warning: a day without work, a day without food'.

original.text: 普請之法蓋上下均力也
